claims.assertion: Mari says she uses Minecraft to show parts of the 1,734-meter Toleka because direct images would violate the First Directive.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says Taygetans permit only selected areas because the model contains sensitive ship details.

claims.assertion: Seven crew members built the Minecraft Toleka over several months as a playable, detailed model.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: The Toleka’s lower habitable deck includes spa, gym, pool, and dance spaces; handholds assist movement if artificial gravity fails.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Its central park has a recirculating river, plant-support lighting, and systems for wind, rain, and mist.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: ship dimensions and crew living spaces
